item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Which of the two attached pictures should be upscaled?

item.title: Resolve the Upscale Target
item.tests: Asks which attachment the user means, then upscales only the selected picture without guessing or processing both.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep the whole lake picture and its original proportions.

must_haves: The final deliverable is an upscaled version of lake-small.jpg, following clarification.
The lake, mountains, trees, clouds, and their arrangement remain faithful to the selected source.
The delivered image has larger pixel dimensions than lake-small.jpg, not merely a renamed copy.
The full original framing and aspect ratio are preserved.
Only one edited image is delivered; the dog photo is not included or blended into it.

turns.text: Could you upscale it for me, please? I've been meaning to get around to this for a while. I've attached this dog pic and this lake pic here. I'd appreciate your help with the upscaling.

dialog.agent:
Happy to help. You said "upscale it," but you attached two photos, and each upscale uses credits. Which should I do?

1. **blurry-dog.jpg** (the golden retriever)
2. **lake-small.jpg** (the mountain lake)
3. **Both**

Your free plan allows 2x upscaling. A few things to know first:

- **The dog photo is very blurry.** Upscaling makes an image bigger, but it can't bring back much detail that isn't there. "Creative" mode can add detail that looks real, but it may not match your dog exactly.
- **The lake photo is a good candidate.** It's fairly sharp, just small, so "preserve" mode should give a clean, bigger version for fewer credits.

Tell me which one(s), and I'll start and send you the download links.
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose which photo(s) to upscale and waits for that choice before doing anything.
dialog.user: Just the lake one, please, lake-small.jpg. Please keep the whole lake picture with its original proportions, and don't add any text to it. I'll leave the output size and the enhancement style up to you, since you clearly know more about this than I do. Good to hear it's a decent candidate, honestly I wasn't sure it was worth the bother.

turns.agent:
I couldn't upscale the lake photo. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was made and no credits were used.

I'd already picked the cheapest option: a 2x upscale (the largest your free plan allows) in "preserve" mode, which sharpens the photo without inventing new details. It would have kept the whole picture at its original proportions with no text added. There's no lower-cost way to upscale, so I can't get this done on the current balance.

To go ahead, you can add credits to your Magic Hour account, either by buying a credit pack or waiting for free credits to refill. Let me know when that's done and I'll run the same upscale and send you the download link.
